title: Traefik CRDs still on the deprecated traefik.containo.us API group
quote: In `v2.10`, the Kubernetes CRDs API Group `traefik.containo.us` is deprecated, and its support will end starting with Traefik v3. Please use the API Group `traefik.io` instead.
remediation: Migrate the listed objects to the `traefik.io` API group while still on v2, where BOTH groups are served and the move is reversible. This is the single most valuable thing to do before a v3 upgrade: v3 removes `traefik.containo.us` outright, so anything left on it stops routing the moment the new version starts.
verifyCommand: kubectl get ingressroutes.traefik.containo.us,ingressroutetcps.traefik.containo.us,middlewares.traefik.containo.us -A 2>/dev/null # any rows = objects to migrate before v3; a NotFound error = the legacy CRDs are already gone

title: Nomad provider namespace option deprecated

detection.reason: the Nomad provider is not part of any Kubernetes object collected for this cluster

quote: In `v2.10`, the `namespace` option of the Nomad provider is deprecated, please use the `namespaces` options instead.
remediation: Not applicable to a Kubernetes-only deployment. If the same configuration also drives a Nomad provider, switch `namespace` to the plural `namespaces`.

title: Traefik Hub configuration removed

detection.reason: checked in the Traefik workload's container args only (Deployment or DaemonSet) — an option set through a static configuration file or environment variables is not scanned

quote: In `v2.10`, Traefik Hub configuration has been removed because Traefik Hub v2 doesn't require this configuration.
remediation: Remove any leftover Traefik Hub block from the static configuration; Hub v2 does not need it. Note this concerns Traefik Hub, a separate product from Traefik Proxy.
